bio.text: John E. Sununu, a Republican, represented New Hampshire's 1st Congressional District in the U.S. House beginning in 1997 and was elected to the U.S. Senate in 2002.
He served in the Senate from 2003 to 2009 and lost his 2008 re-election bid to Jeanne Shaheen.
He announced in October 2025 that he would seek the Senate seat Shaheen is vacating, and he is listed on the November 3, 2026 general-election ballot as the Republican candidate.

sources.title: Nearly two decades later, John E. Sununu wants New Hampshire to send him back to the U.S. Senate
